output.headline: Sponsor with an open platform in the target's sub-sector, six Midwest deals and a record of paying above the comparable upper quartile.
output.differentiator: Offers an add-on route through an open platform in the sub-sector, with a median 16.2x paid against the comparable 75th percentile of 15.3x. Midwest is its largest region. [A:angles, T:record, V:comps]
output.why_them: Add-on to open platform; pays above upper-quartile comps

acquirer_overview.title: Active provider-focused sponsor with a steady record since 2017
points: Financial sponsor with 23 deals from 2017 to 2023, 18 of them closed (78%); 8 deals since 2022. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:recent]
Focuses on technology and healthcare; raised over $5 Billion in its largest private equity fund to date (July 2023 headline). [P:1, P:2]
Mostly control deals (21 of 23, 91%); median deal $172M, and 9 of 23 fall in the $100M-$400M band. [K:control_share, T:record, K:size_band]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by a provider record
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors are a modest factor; it has 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors. [S:sector_rel, T:record]
Its open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on; its angles are provider specialist and size fit. [A:angles]
Cross-sell is a stand-out motive: 8 of 23 deals, against 21% across the file. Midwest is its top region at 6 deals. [M:cross_sell, K:by_region]

precedent_activity.title: Midwest and platform-scale precedents show it can transact at this size
points: Jefferson Ambulatory Care: $75M management buyout, 2021, Midwest, in the target's own sub-sector, closed at 17.8x EV/EBITDA. [D:MA-2021-0083]
Woodland PACE: $204M management buyout, 2021, closed at 17.6x, close to the target's $200M size. [D:MA-2021-0025]
Clearwater Mental Health: $398M Midwest recapitalization, 2023, at 16.8x, but withdrawn. [D:MA-2023-0166]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, but the return at the ask is thin
points: Across 70 comparable deals, EV/EBITDA runs from 10.7x (25th percentile) to 12.8x (median) and 15.3x (75th percentile). [V:comps]
The target's 16.8% margin beats the comps' median of 12.9% and is above 87% of comps, supporting the 75th percentile. Welsh Carson's own median paid is 16.2x. [V:comps]
With 5.0x leverage and a $128M equity cheque, IRR at the ask is 18.7% against a 20% target. Maximum price is $193M at the same exit, $216M with a platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only if it underwrites the add-on exit; at the same exit the maximum is $193M. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Completion record
risk_flags.concern: The share of deals that closed is a slight factor against; 18 of 23 (78%) closed. [S:close_rate_s, K:closed_share]
risk_flags.mitigant: Both Midwest and own-sub-sector precedents that were in scope closed, including Jefferson Ambulatory Care. [D:MA-2021-0083]
risk_flags.reality: Clearwater ($398M, Midwest) and Delta Multispecialty Group were withdrawn, so certainty of close needs testing. [D:MA-2023-0166, D:MA-2022-0024]

risk_flags.title: Thin own-sub-sector depth
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 of its 23 deals is in the target's own sub-sector. [T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: 15 deals sit in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and the open platform gives an add-on route. [T:record, A:angles]
risk_flags.reality: Fit rests on provider breadth and the platform, not a deep own-sub-sector record. [S:sector_rel]

conviction.rationale: Rests on 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, plus an open platform in the sub-sector that provides an add-on route. [T:record, A:angles]
